### Props

| Name               | Type                 | Required | Default                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------- | -------- | -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `registry`         | `object`             |          | `null`                     | Optional registry override (used in tests so registrations don't leak across cases). Defaults to the singleton.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `register`         | `string&#124;object` |          | `''`                       | OpenRegister register id — a slug/uuid string, or the register OBJECT a detail page injects. Accepts both for the same reason `schema` does; see below.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `schema`           | `string&#124;object` |          | `''`                       | OpenRegister schema — a slug/uuid string, or the schema OBJECT the detail-page widget grid injects. This used to be `type: String`, and a detail page handed it the resolved object instead. Vue reported the mismatch as a dev-only warning ("Expected String with value \\"[object Object]\\", got Object") and then passed the object through unchanged, so the leaf built `/apps/openregister/api/schemas/[object Object]` and got a 404 — an unreadable URL rather than a named failure, and silent in production where the warning is compiled out. `CnAuditTrailWidget` already accepted both shapes and collapsed the object to its slug; this mirrors that so the two widgets cannot disagree about what a detail page may hand them. |
| `objectId`         | `string&#124;number` |          | `''`                       | Parent object id. Forwarded to each leaf.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `only`             | `string`             |          | `''`                       | Single-integration mode: render ONLY this leaf id with no tab strip. The manifest multi-placement entry point (ADR-024).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `surface`          | `string`             |          | `'detail-page'`            | Rendering surface — filters integrations by `surfaces.includes()` when a descriptor declares a `surfaces` allowlist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `include`          | `string[]&#124;null` |          | `null`                     | Explicit allowlist of leaf ids to show as tabs. | `objectType`       | `string`             |          | `''`                       | Optional object type forwarded to each leaf content component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `documentationUrl` | `string`             |          | `''`                       | Documentation link target for the header's shared Actions menu.
